Q5455.reason: SARMs are nonsteroidal androgen-receptor ligands that act as tissue-selective agonists, mimicking anabolic effects of androgens rather than blocking them.

Q5460.reason: A coworker admission is admissible only if it concerns a matter within that employee’s job scope, and wall reinforcement is outside a painter’s duties, so the hearsay objection stands.

Q5466.reason: The threat was a simple assault with no intent to kill or cause serious injury and no knowledge of the heart condition, so an unintended death is involuntary manslaughter under the misdemeanor-manslaughter rule.
